doNotRemoveData.description: If true, {@link ReliabilityControlValvesTestData#removeTestData} will not be run before loading data.

defaultTargetTag.description:
The default target tag for the {@link ReliabilityAsset}s to be created.

**NOTE**: The provided {@link ExpectedSensor} must be specified in {@link ReliabilityMlControlValvesConfig#targetExpectedSensors}.
If not, the field will be ignored and will be set randomly according to the config.

start.description: The start time of the {@link Sensor} measurement data to be generated.

end.description: The start time of the {@link Sensor} measurement data to be generated.

interval.description:
The interval of the {@link Sensor} measurement data to be generated.
Every measurement's `start` time will be one `interval` greater than the previous measurement.

numSensorsPerPlantWithSameMeasurementVal.description:
The number of {@link Sensor}s per plant to be created with the same measurement values.
This is useful for analyzing the correlation values.

**NOTE**: This value will clamp to 0 or {@link #numExternalSensorsInPlant}.

constantSensorMeasurementValue.description:
The constant value to be used for the measurement of the `external` {@link Sensor}s configured to be specified
with the same value. This value will be padded with random noise in the interval (0, 1] as external sensors
with exact measurements are ruled out when generating correlations.

title: Type as an input argument for {@link ReliabilityControlValvesTestData#loadTestData} to create basic test data for Reliability Control Valves.
name: ReliabilityControlValvesTestDataOptions
